# FolioCove

> Browser PDF tools with on-device document processing. Owner-private beta; not yet publicly indexed.

## Product and guides

- [Tool directory](https://foliocove-tools.mehbulislam81.chatgpt.site/tools/): all 88 tools, purposes and limits
- [How it works](https://foliocove-tools.mehbulislam81.chatgpt.site/testing/): local processing and beta status
- [Capabilities](https://foliocove-tools.mehbulislam81.chatgpt.site/docs/capabilities.md): complete plain-text capability guide
- [Machine-readable catalog](https://foliocove-tools.mehbulislam81.chatgpt.site/capabilities.json): tool IDs, input formats, URLs and status
- [Limitations](https://foliocove-tools.mehbulislam81.chatgpt.site/limitations/): experimental and unavailable features
- [Privacy](https://foliocove-tools.mehbulislam81.chatgpt.site/privacy/): storage and network requests

## Important boundaries

AI summary and translation are browser-dependent. Redaction is experimental. Verified sanitization and PDF/A conversion are unavailable. There is no document-upload endpoint or remote processing API. Support email and physical-device validation remain pending.
